entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Just get me a person already. This is ridiculous!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Charlie, I need to return a helmet I bought. And I need it done now. I've had it with this company.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'll just need an order number to start.
Ugh, fine. It's VF88602. And you better not give me the runaround. I will light you up on social media if this isn't handled.
I understand your frustration, sir. I'm just pulling up order VF88602 now... Okay, I see the Urban Commuter Helmet, delivered about 60 days ago. Can you tell me what the issue is?
The issue is I don't want it! The color is completely wrong, it looks nothing like the website. The box is unopened, it's basically brand new. I want my money back.
I see. I'm sorry to hear the color wasn't what you expected. We always want our customers to feel good about their gear, as both style and safety are important.
I don't need a speech, I need a refund! Are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager right now? This is my last attempt before I file a chargeback.

That won't be necessary, sir. Let me just confirm our return policy for you... One moment. Okay, I've checked here. For a standard item like this helmet, our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery.
Wait, really? So you're actually going to take it back?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's been 60 days, you are well within the window. And since you've stated the box is unopened, we can process a full refund for you. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just attach that to the box and drop it off with the carrier.
Huh. Okay. Well, that's what you should have done in the first place. Fine. Make sure that email comes through.
It's already been sent. Once we receive the helmet at our warehouse, your refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Just get it done.
We will. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
